publication.title: GUI-Based Software Testing: An Automated Approach Using GPT-4 and Selenium WebDriver
publication.venue: 2023 38th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering Workshops (ASEW)

name: GUI-Based Software Testing: An Automated Approach Using GPT-4 and Selenium WebDriver
notes: The authors built a web calculator with integrated code coverage measurement. They report higher branch coverage than monkey testing and describe testing without recorded human tester data.
summary: A web GUI testing method combines GPT-4 with Selenium WebDriver and compares its branch coverage with random monkey testing on a web calculator.
